# Hassan Zaki — AI & Computational Biology Portfolio

> Computational Biology Researcher & AI Systems Engineer building end-to-end deep learning architectures and data-centric solutions for life sciences and scientific discovery.

## Core Competencies
- Applied AI, Deep Learning & Graph Neural Networks (GNNs, AttentiveFP, PyTorch Geometric, TensorFlow)
- Full-Stack Software & Distributed Backend Systems (FastAPI, React, TypeScript, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Redis)
- Data Engineering & MLOps (Docker, CI/CD, Automated ETL, Linux, Open Science Reproducibility)
- Cheminformatics & Bio-AI (RDKit, 3D Conformer Modeling, Molecular Descriptors, Ecotoxicology AI)

## Featured Projects
1. **AgroGraph-Tox AI**: Multi-Task Graph Neural Network predicting acute honeybee toxicity and environmental safety.
2. **Sentinel-1 SAR Flood AI**: Cloud-native radar hydrology pipeline and interactive tactical flood intelligence system.
3. **EchoGuard Biometric Edge AI**: Embedded ultra-low latency acoustic keyword spotting on ESP32 microcontrollers.
4. **BioPhys Conformer Benchmark**: 3D molecular conformation modeling and coordinate standardization.
5. **NeuroScan SHAP Diagnostic**: Deep convolutional neural network for automated breast neoplasm triage with SHAP explainability.
6. **Smart IoT Bioreactor**: Real-time closed-loop environmental telemetry and fermentation monitoring.

## Open Science & Publications
- **AgroBench-3D**: 11,129 Curated 3D Molecular Conformer Benchmark on Hugging Face (Hassan2007/EcoAgro3D).
- Peer-reviewed research papers and preprints indexed with DOIs and Open Access links.
